decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix draws on the firm's established nutrient-from-biomass knowledge, which helps it interpret early results, but it is a consumer food product with only a website mention, so the risk of dropping it is moderate.

The modular waste-to-energy extensions build directly on the firm's core engineering and prototyping knowledge, so in-house R&D and university cooperation let it assimilate feedback and refine the line.
The waste oil to energy plant is a flagship with its own page and builds on established competencies, giving the firm strong absorptive capacity to learn from it and improve it.
The plastic-to-fuel plant is a flagship close to the firm's waste-conversion expertise, and its own R&D and research cooperation support developing it despite its somewhat newer technology.
